text: dsh-email 是面向 DSH 网页端的邮件工作台，可连接多个邮箱账号并在 DSH 工具和设置界面中使用。它注册邮件读取、搜索、标记、回复、发送、附件、文件夹、健康检查和监视等工具，并提供邮箱设置、收件箱和草稿页面。支持 IMAP/SMTP、POP3、AgentMail 及 OAuth2 账号。适合需要在 DSH 会话中处理邮件的用户；需配置邮箱账号与相应认证信息。

dsh-email brings email into DSH web with account settings, mailbox and draft pages, and tools to list, read, search, reply to, and send messages. It supports IMAP/SMTP, POP3, AgentMail, and OAuth2 accounts. Configure a mail account to use it.

dsh-email 的功能「邮件搜索」：email_search 可按查询词、文件夹和日期范围搜索邮件，并返回分页结果。
dsh-email 的功能「本地草稿」：email_draft 保存待编辑草稿，用户可在设置页面检查内容和附件后再确认发送。
dsh-email 的功能「网页收件箱」：插件安装邮箱设置与收件箱页面，供用户在 DSH 网页端管理和浏览邮件。
dsh-email 的功能「多种邮件传输」：服务按账号路由 IMAP、POP3 与 AgentMail；IMAP/AgentMail 支持搜索读取等操作。
dsh-email 的功能「邮件操作工具」：工具集提供邮件列表、读取、标记、回复、发送、附件、文件夹和连接健康检查。

dsh-email README · 安装：在 DSH 桌面版「插件」面板安装 `dsh-email`。已配置命令行时也可使用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-email
```

网页版把 `desktop` 改为 `web`；安装后重启对应的 DSH。宿主要求以包声明 `>=0.2.1-rc.3` 为准。

dsh-email README · 开始使用：1. 打开“邮件”的账号设置，选择自己的 IMAP/SMTP、OAuth 或 AgentMail 账号并填写授权信息。
2. 测试连接，选择要使用的账号，再从“收发邮件”读取收件箱和已发送。
3. 搜索并打开邮件，核对正文与附件；可让助手“准备回复，先不要发送”。
4. 到“草稿”编辑、保存和检查预览，核对 To/Cc、附件和发信账号后再确认发送。
5. 在已发送或原邮件线程中核对结果；收件人禁止规则始终优先。

可以这样说：

> 读取这封邮件，准备一封回复草稿，先不要发送。

dsh-email README · 开始前要知道：需要自己的邮箱授权或 AgentMail API Key；POP3 的状态与搜索范围按协议说明。网络必须经代理才能连上邮箱服务器时，给账号加 `proxy`（或用 `HTTPS_PROXY`），见[使用说明](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-email/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md)。

配置、完整工具与排错见[详细使用说明](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-email/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.zh.md)。

dsh-email README · Features：- Use IMAP/POP3/SMTP, Outlook OAuth or AgentMail accounts.
- Read messages, search and download attachments in the workbench.
- Review the sender, To/Cc, content and attachments before confirming.

dsh-email README · Features：Formatted reading, longer quoted replies, and IMAP single/bulk Trash with Undo: see the [mailbox workflow](docs/MAILBOX.en.md). You choose whether to load external images and confirm moves before they run.

dsh-email README · Install：Open **Plugins** in the DSH desktop app and install `dsh-email`. If the CLI is available:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-email
```

For the web profile, replace `desktop` with `web`. Restart that DSH profile after installation. The package’s DSH requirement is `>=0.2.1-rc.3`.

dsh-email README · Start using it：1. Open Email account settings and configure your own IMAP/SMTP, OAuth or AgentMail account.
2. Test the connection, select an account and browse Inbox and Sent in the mail workbench.
3. Search and open a message, inspect its body and attachments, then ask for a reply draft without sending.
4. Edit, save and preview the draft; verify To/Cc, attachments and sending account before confirming.
5. Verify the result in Sent or the original thread. Recipient deny rules continue to take precedence.

dsh-email README · Start using it：Example request：

> Read this message and prepare a reply draft. Do not send it yet.

dsh-email README · Before you start：Bring your mailbox authorization or AgentMail API key. POP3 has protocol-specific state and search limits. When the network only reaches a mail server through a proxy, add `proxy` to the account (or set `HTTPS_PROXY`); see the [usage guide](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-email/blob/main/docs/USAGE.en.md).

Configuration, detailed tools and troubleshooting: [full reference](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-email/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md).

dsh-email README · Plugin updates：Check updates at the bottom of the workbench or native plugin details. Automatic checks are on by default; **automatic installation is off**. You choose whether to install and when to restart. Suite-managed components update with their bundle. [Update behavior](https://github.com/STARDUSTLC666/dsh-email/blob/main/docs/REFERENCE.en.md).
